topic: No logs on trace side panel
symptom_pattern: The 'Logs' tab on traces is always empty for one service even though its logs are in Log Explorer.
root_cause: Logs injection is disabled (DD_LOGS_INJECTION=false), so log lines carry no dd.trace_id/dd.span_id to correlate on.
resolution_path: Enable injection and confirm trace ids are parsed by the pipeline

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you paste a raw log line from that service?

qa_pairs.customer_answer: It's false in our env file; I don't know why.
